title: Preferences
description: Configuration read by agent skills. Resolved from .agents/preferences.yaml at the project level, with ~/.agents/preferences.yaml as a global fallback.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference URI for editor tooling.

artifacts.description: Artifact storage configuration: where generated artifacts live and how they are categorized.

base_dir.description: Root directory for all generated artifacts. Supports `~` expansion. Default: `~/ai-artifacts`.

paths.description: Maps artifact category names (e.g., `chats`, `devlogs`, `plans`) to subdirectory names relative to the project artifact directory. Any category key is permitted; values must be strings.

commit.description: Commit-title rendering configuration consumed by the `describe-change.mjs` script.

title_format.description: Template string used to render commit titles. Supports the tokens `{scope}`, `{type}`, `{breaking}`, `{title}`, and `{ticket_ref}`, and nesting `[...]` groups that drop when a token directly inside them resolves empty.

editors.description: Optional list of editor configurations mapping file extensions to an editor command.

command.description: Shell command to open files. The file path is appended as an argument.

extensions.description: Glob pattern for file types this editor handles (e.g., `*.md`).

integrations.description: Per-integration configuration. Keys are integration names (e.g., `jira`, `github`, `linear`); each integration object must declare an `enabled` boolean.

jira.description: Jira integration configuration. Beyond `enabled`, the keys here are read by the `manage-jira-ticket` helper, which the `create-ticket` skill runs to create a Jira work item.

issue_types.description: Maps work-type keys and aliases (from the work-type taxonomy, e.g. `feat`, `fix`, `bugfix`) to Jira issue-type names, plus a `default` entry covering every unmapped work type. A created work item whose work type matches neither falls back to `Task`.

project_key.description: Key of the Jira project to create work items in (e.g., `MAC`). Overrides the key derived from `project.ticket_ref_prefix` minus its trailing separator.

merge.description: Squash-merge title rendering configuration for the `merge-pr` skill family.

title_format.description: Template string used to render the squash-merge commit title. Supports the same token vocabulary as `commit.title_format`, plus `{pr_number}`.

strategy.description: Reserved key. Not yet honored by the `merge-pr` skill family — the skill currently performs squash merges unconditionally. Recorded here so the schema does not flag the key as unknown when projects opt to set it in anticipation of future support.

delete_branch.description: Reserved key. Not yet honored by the `merge-pr` skill family — branch deletion is currently controlled by command-line flags and platform defaults. Recorded here so the schema does not flag the key as unknown when projects opt to set it in anticipation of future support.

platform.description: Deprecated legacy spelling of `scm`, retained so existing preferences files validate during the migration window. Prefer `scm`; a future release removes this alias.

title_format.description: Template string used to render pull-request titles. Supports the same token vocabulary as `commit.title_format`.

scopes.description: Directories that own a change scope although they are not workspace packages, such as an app built by another toolchain. `describe-change resolve-scopes` resolves paths against these together with the pnpm workspace's packages, the longest containing directory winning. Read from the project preferences file only; the global file contributes no scopes. A declared directory does not become a workspace to any tool.

name.description: Scope name. Defaults to the directory's basename, and overrides the basename of a package directory with the same path.

path.description: Directory relative to the repository root. An absolute path, a path outside the repository, and a path that is not an existing directory are skipped with a warning.

slug.description: Project identifier used for namespacing artifacts under `{base_dir}/projects/{slug}/`.

ticket_ref_prefix.description: Prefix that appears at the start of `ticket_ref`. Use `#` for GitHub issues (added at render time, omitted from file paths) or a Jira project key like `MAC-` (part of the canonical ticket ID).

repository.description: Repository configuration: default remote and (deprecated) project slug fallback.

default_remote.description: Default git remote used when constructing remote refs such as `origin/main`.

name.description: Name of the default git remote (e.g., `origin`).

slug.description: Deprecated. Use `project.slug` instead. Kept as a fallback.

scm.description: Source-code-management host. Supported values are `github` and `bitbucket`; new hosts can be added additively.

ticket.description: Ticket (issue) configuration: title rendering and the base URL used to resolve bare ticket references.

title_format.description: Template string used to render ticket (issue) titles. Supports the same token vocabulary as `commit.title_format`.

base_url.description: Org-stable base URL that a bare ticket id is appended to when reconstructing a ticket URL, for platforms where the URL cannot otherwise be derived (e.g. Jira `https://org.atlassian.net/browse/`). The trailing slash is optional. Surfaced into the branch manifest as `ticket_base_url`.

pull.description: Settings of the `pull-from-backlog` skill, read from the project preferences file only.

assignOnPick.description: Assign the user to a picked ticket without asking first.

now.description: Title of the open milestone that forms the Now set. Without it, the Now set is the open milestone with the nearest due date, else the open milestone with the most open issues, else the whole backlog.

priorityPrefix.description: Prefix of the priority labels. The value after it ranks `high`, `medium`, then `low`; any other value ranks as unlabelled.

staleBranchDays.description: Days since an in-progress branch's last commit at which the skill warns about it.

staleGroomDays.description: Days since the last groom at which the skill offers `/groom-backlog`.

staleGroomNewTickets.description: Open tickets created since the last groom at which the skill offers `/groom-backlog`.
